title: PromptBill Launches Live LLM API Pricing & Endpoint News Feed
summary: Track verified per-1M token rate shifts, new model launches, and endpoint updates across OpenRouter, Together AI, DeepInfra, Fireworks, and Bedrock.
keyTakeaways: Every rate shift, new model launch, and inference endpoint change approved in PromptBill Admin publishes directly to /news.
Articles include structured NewsArticle JSON-LD metadata and links to per-1M token calculators and multi-provider comparisons.

sections.heading: Why Live Rate Tracking Matters
sections.body: Inference providers frequently adjust input, output, and cached-read token rates across hosted endpoints. PromptBill logs verified pricing deltas alongside direct links to model detail pages and token cost calculators so engineering teams can audit spend before updating production routing.
